name: Agent Control Plane Review
description: Review an agent workflow for identity, gateway, policy, approval, inspection, and audit coverage before it touches production systems.

operational.approval_boundary: Analysis-only; must not grant permissions, create credentials, or enable production tool access.
operational.use_when: Use before deploying or expanding an agent workflow that can call tools, access data, or trigger operational actions.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
